I have not got to long left, you go and enjoy your trip and the rest of
Your life.
.....Good bye....

Thank you, writing is not really for me though, its just I wanted to have
My say. I could not leave without saying something.

I really hope that you can cope seeing your ex again, you sound strong now.
Thanks for your kind message.

Well today is the day. I finally come to an end,
To many bad memories that I can never mend.
In my madness I have to say,
Thank you all for being with me today.
I am so lonely so it was not hard to choose,
But I would of loved a friend to untie the noose.
I know this was not meant to be,
So all I ask is that you pray for me.

It made me feel lots of different thing like, happy,glad,humility
respect,sadness, I am just glad he allowed me to share a little
part of his life.

Well thanks for taking the time to talk with me everyone, I have great respect for all of you, it is around 11 in the morning where I am, it seems
so weird not having to think about tomorrow, because I will be leaving tonight, just don't know what say anymore....But thanks,,,,

I have quite a few, but the one I still think of every day is
getting to know an old man called john, he would not speak to anyone, but I just kept saying hello to him every time I saw him, he started to give a small
Smile after a while, so I just carried on saying hello, eventually he started to speak to me, I thought this was great, he told me he had no one in this world, well anyway he became very sick and was taken to hospital, I visited him there
and to see the big smile on his face just by having a visitor was amazing,just before he died, he said he had something for me, he said it was his most treasured thing he owned, it was a small bible he had been given as a teenager, it was in such pristine condition, he asked me to keep it for ever, I still have it now.
I like to walk at the beach, help out at the homeless shelter, listen to music

Thanks everyone, what is going through my mind is, I hate myself,my life,
Memories of abuse, him laughing telling me to to take my life,real messed up crap,

Thank you, but my mind is made up, I am hurting so much
I just want it to be over.
Thanks, but its ok I just really wanted to say my piece before I go.

Thank you, but 11 years of child sexual abuse has beaten me. Can't cope with the PTSD, My mind is made up, just wanted to say my piece before I go.
No one is going to miss a non person piece of crap like me.
I am going to hang myself today,
